env GK111MODULE=off

cd mycmd
go build mycmd

# cross-compile install with implicit GKBIN=$GKPATH/bin can make subdirectory
env GKARCH=386
[GKARCH:386] env GKARCH=amd64
env GKOS=linux
go install mycmd
exists $GKPATH/bin/linux_$GKARCH/mycmd

# cross-compile install with explicit GKBIN cannot make subdirectory
env GKBIN=$WORK/bin
! go install mycmd
! exists $GKBIN/linux_$GKARCH

# The install directory for a cross-compiled standard command should include GKARCH.
go list -f '{{.Target}}'  cmd/pack
stdout ${GKROOT}[/\\]pkg[/\\]tool[/\\]${GKOS}_${GKARCH}[/\\]pack$

-- mycmd/x.go --
package main
func main() {}
